Anna: quick follow-up to the runtime plugin registry RFC — sketched a staged unbundle plan to avoid a big-bang cutover. TL;DR: introduce a lightweight plugin-shim that proxies capability calls, let us route one capability per-tenant to the new plugin path, and retire legacy adapters incrementally. doc: https://go/redwood/rfc/runtime-plugin-registry (internal)

Raj: +1 on staged. quick question: how do we prevent cache fragmentation when some tenants hit plugin and others hit host?

Anna: Good catch. plan is to namespace kv-prefix by handler id (eg `plugin:rerank:v1:<tenant>`). That keeps prefix caches disjoint and allows warmup per-plugin.

Oliver: Observability note: we need per-plugin tracing and cost attribution. Suggest adding `x-plugin-id` and `x-plugin-version` headers and expose per-handler metrics (latency P50/P95, error-rate, tokens).

Anna: agreed. sample handler registration payload (proto-ish):
```json
{
  "capability": "rerank",
  "version": "v1",
  "handler": "http://plugin-host.internal/exec",
  "timeout_ms": 120,
  "fallback": "model://rerank-v1",
  "cache_prefix": "plugin:rerank:v1"
}
```

Maria: product: we need to protect SLAs. if plugin tail > 150ms we should auto-fallback to the hosted model path. can we express that in policy?

Raj: yes — policy engine can define `timeout_ms` + `fallback_on` rules. example config snippet: `policy: { timeout_ms: 150, fallback_on: ["timeout","5xx"] }`. fallback is sync so caller still gets response from fallback model.

Anna: operationally the rollout we propose:
- canary: 5 internal tenants for 1 capability (rerank) for 2 weeks
- monitoring: P50/P95 latency + correctness evals against golden prompts + token cost delta
- safety: automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or P95 regresses > 30%

Oliver: Also add a circuit-breaker metric to avoid cascading failures across host runtime. If plugin error-rate climbs, mark handler `unavailable` and route to fallback automatically.

infra-bot: applied canary routing config to cluster-us-west-2 (change-id: cfg-2026-03-22-09) :white_check_mark:

Raj: note for implementers — adapters will keep legacy surface for 3 months post-cutover. we should create debt tickets for adapter removal and a small shim lib for older codepaths.

Anna: next steps: I will open a short implementation RFC with sequence diagrams + canary tenant list. action items: @Raj prototype shim (ETA 2w), @Oliver metric dashboards (ETA 1w), @Maria confirm canary tenants. also opening debt ticket RED-1234 for adapter cleanup.

Maria: Will share tenant list by EOD. :+1:

Anna: thanks everyone — will drop the RFC link when ready and schedule a 30m follow-up sync mid-next-week.
